title: Ferrari F40 in the Night Studio in the Forest
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Deep work is a quiet flex.
description:
Step inside the quiet warmth of the Night Studio, where a gunmetal grey Ferrari F40 rests in the soft shadows. Just outside the window, a moonlit pine forest breathes quietly as pale mist drifts between the trees. For the next two hours, there is only mellow lo-fi hip hop, filled with jazzy keys and a soft head-nod beat. Settle in and let this peaceful space keep you company while you work, study, or relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
